steps.js: (async () => { await window.__gitgood.actions.addLocalRepository(__REPO_PATH__); window.__gitgood.actions.setView('history'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); window.__gitgood.actions.setHistorySearch('content:needle'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 700)); const s = window.__gitgood.store.get(); return JSON.stringify({ summaries: s.history.commits.map((c) => c.summary).sort().join(','), queryError: s.history.queryError, contentField: s.history.query.content }); })()

(async () => { window.__gitgood.actions.setHistorySearch('regex:needle'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 700)); const s = window.__gitgood.store.get(); return JSON.stringify({ summaries: s.history.commits.map((c) => c.summary).sort().join(','), diffRegexField: s.history.query.diffRegex }); })()

(async () => { const s = window.__gitgood.store.get(); const commit = s.history.commits.find((c) => c.summary === 'change needle line'); window.__gitgood.actions.selectCommit(commit.sha); await window.__gitgood.actions.loadCommitDetails(commit.sha); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); const after = window.__gitgood.store.get(); return JSON.stringify({ matchingFiles: (after.history.matchingFiles || []).join(','), highlightText: after.diff.highlightTerm && after.diff.highlightTerm.text, diffKind: after.diff.diff && after.diff.diff.kind }); })()

(async () => { window.__gitgood.actions.setHistorySearch('regex:('); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); const s = window.__gitgood.store.get(); return JSON.stringify({ hasError: !!s.history.queryError, loading: s.history.loading }); })()

(async () => { window.__gitgood.actions.clearHistoryFilter(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); const s = window.__gitgood.store.get(); return JSON.stringify({ search: s.history.search, commitCount: s.history.commits.length }); })()

(async () => { window.__gitgood.actions.setView('changes'); window.__gitgood.actions.searchHistoryForSelection('computeTotal'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 700)); const s = window.__gitgood.store.get(); return JSON.stringify({ view: s.view, search: s.history.search, content: s.history.query.content }); })()
